title: fix(examples,spec): dashboard widget options census — examples drop the options keys no dataset-bound renderer reads, and the schema doc states the read set
body:
Fixes #20960

Clause-②: no — the census found no key that has both a writer and a reader, so nothing is declared and no value is typed. The accept set of `DashboardWidgetOptionsSchema` is unchanged.

The claim declared `yes` with the arm left to the census. The line above is the measured arm.

## What the census found

No key in the census has both a writer and a reader. Every key an example writes is read by no renderer, and the one key a renderer reads (`description`) has no authored writer. So the card's rule gives these verdicts:

- written but unread: each key is **removed from its producer**;
- read but unwritten: **nothing is declared**.

This PR therefore contains no declarations. It has three parts:

- the producer removals in two example apps;
- a correction to the `DashboardWidgetOptionsSchema` doc comment, which said the renderer "understands" presentation extras that no renderer reads;
- a `patch` changeset, because that doc comment ships in `dist/ui/index.d.ts`.

**Landing site.** This is the expected site from the dispatch, minus the declarations: the producers under `examples/**` and the `DashboardWidgetOptionsSchema` block in `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`.

## Census — every key written through the widget's open shapes

How it was measured:

- **Writers** were read at objectstack `2821e9f15`. The population is every dashboard producer: `examples/**` (app-crm, app-todo, and app-showcase's three dashboards), the packaged templates (`create-objectstack` blank, `os generate`'s dashboard scaffold, Studio's create seed in `metadata-create-seeds.ts`), and the platform package `platform-objects` (`system_overview`).
- **Readers** were read in objectui `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx` at objectui `main` `5262f7dd`. `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout` both route any widget that has a `dataset` to `DatasetWidget`, and the spec requires `dataset`. The objectui pin `e420df310` reads the same set (`:492`-`:501`, `:1065`, `:1694` there).
- **Open shapes:** walked at runtime from the built `DashboardWidgetSchema`, the widget has exactly one open catchall: `options`. The widget itself, `layout`, `compareTo` and `chartConfig` are closed. The four maps it reaches are the `title` locale map, `chartConfig.colors`, `filter` (filter grammar keyed by field name) and `filterBindings` (filter name to field). None of the four is a renderer-extras bag.

| Key | Writer | Reader on the dataset-bound path | Verdict |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `format` | app-crm `pipeline.dashboard.ts` L46, L64, L82 (`'currency'`) | None. The metric tile formats with the dataset measure's own metadata: `formatMeasure(value, f?.format, f?.currency, …)` at `:1126`, where `f = measureField(values[0])` at `:1043`. `opportunity.dataset.ts` already declares `format: '0,0', currency: 'USD'` on `total_amount` and `avg_amount`. | Written, unread. Removed from the producer. |
| `currency` | app-crm, same three widgets (`'USD'`) | None (same read as `format`) | Written, unread. Removed. |
| `color` | app-todo, four metric tiles (hex colours) | None. A tile's accent is `widget.colorVariant` (`metricAccentTextClass(widget?.colorVariant)` at `:1071`). | Written, unread. Removed. |
| `suffix` | app-todo `completion_rate` (`'%'`) | None | Written, unread. Removed. |
| `showLegend` | app-todo pie and donut (`true`) | None. The legend comes from `widget.chartConfig` (`chartConfigPresentation(widget?.chartConfig, …)` at `:1800`), where `showLegend` defaults to `true`. | Written, unread. Removed. |
| `horizontal` | app-todo bar (`true`) | None. The declared spelling is `type: 'horizontal-bar'`. | Written, unread. Removed. |
| `showDataLabels` | app-todo line (`true`) | None. The declared home is `chartConfig.showDataLabels`. | Written, unread. Removed. |
| `description` | No authored writer. The single-line grep and every dashboard file read by hand both found none, and the grep's control hit is `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx`. `translateDashboard` (`system/i18n-resolver.ts`) only overlays the key from a `subCaption` bundle entry, and this repo ships no such entry. | Metric sub-caption: `pickLocalized(options.description, …)` at `:1118` | Read, unwritten. Not declared. The seat note (5925333725) records objectui#11228 ruling C, which keeps this key refused by name as an inline-dialect key, so dropping the read is objectui's follow-up. |

The declared keys (`dateGranularity`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `limit`, `stageOrder`) are unchanged. `DatasetWidget` reads them at `:541`-`:551` and `:1785`.

The one place outside the example apps that still writes an extra is the published skill `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md:185`, which writes `options: { icon: 'DollarSign' }`. That file is teaching text on a Tier H governed surface, so it is reported for the seat and not edited here (Acceptance notes).

A reader for most of these keys exists only on objectui's legacy inline arm. There, `DashboardRenderer.getComponentSchema` spreads `...options` into component props, and for example `MetricWidget` reads `format`, `currency` and `suffix`. A widget that has a `dataset` never reaches that arm. That arm is the inline dialect objectui#11228 ruled C, which is out of scope here.

## Mechanism hypotheses, measured

- **H1 (census first)** — held. The census table is above.
- **H2 (typing follows the reader)** — moot, because `currency` has no reader to type from. A finding from the search: `packages/spec` has no shared ISO 4217 code schema. `z.string().length(3)` is spelled three times (`data/field.zod.ts:485`, `:509` and `ui/dataset.zod.ts:288`), and the `iso_4217_currency` value domain (`data/currency-fraction-digits.ts`) is a separate membership list.
- **H3 (what typing breaks)** — zero. No value is typed, so nothing the catchall admitted is now refused. `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` exits 0 on a `patch` changeset that declares `no`.
- **H4 (strict face)** — measured with a scratch replica of objectui `strict-authoring-face.ts`'s walker (`5262f7dd`). The replica gives every reachable object `catchall: z.never()` and walks lazy, union, array, tuple, record, set, map, intersection, pipe and the optional family. It was applied to the built spec `DashboardSchema`. This is a faithful reading of the walker, not objectui's own face:

  ```
  control-lit    tolerant=FAIL strict=FAIL(3)   unrecognized_keys @ widgets.0.options keys=["zzProbe"] (+2 id-length issues of the fixture)
  crm-before     tolerant=PASS strict=FAIL(3)   unrecognized_keys @ widgets.{0,1,2}.options keys=["format","currency"]
  crm-after      tolerant=PASS strict=PASS
  todo-before    tolerant=PASS strict=FAIL(8)   color x4, suffix, showLegend x2, horizontal, showDataLabels
  todo-after     tolerant=PASS strict=PASS
  ```

  app-crm's `pipeline.dashboard.ts` now carries no `options` at all, so it passes the strict face without any objectui follow-up. The run link the card's acceptance asks for is the closer's to add, from objectui's own strict-face run over this example.

## Changes

- `examples/app-crm/src/dashboards/pipeline.dashboard.ts` — drop `options: { format: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }` from the three metric tiles, with a comment pointing at the dataset measures that carry the currency.
- `examples/app-todo/src/dashboards/task.dashboard.ts` — drop `options` from all eight widgets, with a comment naming the declared homes (`colorVariant`, `chartConfig`, the measure's `format`).
- `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` — the `DashboardWidgetOptionsSchema` doc comment, and only that comment. It no longer says the renderer "understands `icon`, `trend`, `columns`, `striped`, `density`". It states:
  - the measured read set: the five declared keys, plus `description` as read but unwritten;
  - the rule that a key is declared only with both a writer and a dataset-bound read site;
  - the declared homes for presentation.

  `.describe()` is unchanged. The generated reference page shows only the describe text, and `check:docs` is green.
- `.changeset/20960-widget-options-census.md` — a `patch` for `@objectstack/spec`. The doc comment ships in `dist/ui/index.d.ts`; this was checked by grepping the built `.d.ts`. The examples are `private: true` and ship nothing.

## Verification (head `9efd8ffa5`)

- **Spec build:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` exits 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` prints `✓ All 15 generated artifacts are up to date`.
- **Gate derivation:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, with no paths, derived 80 commands from the four changed files. All 80 were run. Reconciliation with `--ran` prints `80 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 79 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` because it needs the whole workspace built (86 package dists). CI's Build Core runs it.
- **Gate verdict lines:**
  - `check:widget-option-census`: `OK  check-widget-option-census: 5 key(s) declared by DashboardWidgetOptionsSchema are all in CONSUMED_WIDGET_OPTION_KEYS (6 member(s)); 1 non-declared member(s) each still witnessed.`
  - `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, `check:api-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`, `check:objectui-pin-citations`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:doc-authoring` and `check:nul-bytes` all exit 0.
- **eslint, narrowed:** run on the three touched TypeScript files with `--no-inline-config --format json`. It reported 3 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings. `--print-config` resolves a config for each file, so none is ignored. The narrowing excludes nothing: `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules, as stated at `:327`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
- **Tests:** shown in the table below.

| Package | Command | Result | Tree |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `@objectstack/spec` | `test` | 588 files, 17239 tests passed | `ef4a1f5a7` |
| `@objectstack/spec` | `typecheck` (tsc, scripts, test-typecheck) | OK | `ef4a1f5a7` |
| `example-crm` | `test` + `typecheck` | 45 tests passed; typecheck Done | `9efd8ffa5` |
| `example-todo` | `test` + `typecheck` | 238 tests passed; typecheck Done | `9efd8ffa5` |
| `@objectstack/sdui-parser` | `test` | 217 passed | `ef4a1f5a7` |
| `@objectstack/service-analytics` | `test` | 3498 passed, 10 skipped | `ef4a1f5a7` |

| `@objectstack/objectql` | `test` | 6874 passed | `ef4a1f5a7` |
| `@objectstack/metadata` | `test` | 836 passed | `ef4a1f5a7` |
| `@objectstack/cli` | `vitest run --project unit`, all 4 shards | 1005 + 843 + 778 + 793 passed (60 files each) | shard 1 at `ef4a1f5a7`, shards 2–4 at `9efd8ffa5` |

Notes on the test table:

- `ef4a1f5a7` is this branch's change on `2821e9f15`, before `main` was merged.
- The consumer packages were run in the upstream-dependency direction, with each package's dependency closure built through `turbo run build --filter=PKG...`.
- After the merge, only the spec doc comment changed on this branch, so their CI rerun is the post-merge reading.
- The CLI integration tier is declared to CI.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- **Teaching surfaces** still describe unread `options` extras as working:
  - `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx:138` says "keys the renderer understands (`icon`, `columns`, `striped`, `density`, …) pass through untouched".
  - `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md:185` and `:341` write `options: { icon: 'DollarSign' }` and say "presentation extras … pass through untouched". The skill is Tier H, so neither file is edited here. Both go to the seat with the report.
- **Silent at validate:** in this repo, nothing runs `checkDashboardWidgetOptions` over dashboard metadata. Only SDUI page dashboard nodes reach it (`sdui-parser/src/validate.ts:318`). So a `*.dashboard.ts` carrying an unread `options` key is silent at `os validate`, which is how these 11 widgets carried them. This goes to the seat with the report.
- **Mislabelled tile:** the app-todo `completion_rate` tile is titled "Completion Rate" but renders `task_count`. Its removed `suffix: '%'` never rendered.
- **Not migrated:** the removed app-todo keys have declared homes, but those were not used because they would change what the example renders: `chartConfig.showDataLabels` for the line chart, and `type: 'horizontal-bar'` for the bar chart. A hex `color` has no faithful `colorVariant` mapping.
- **Stale comment:** app-crm `pipeline.dashboard.ts`'s header comment still describes `categoryGranularity: 'month'` bucketing on the trend widget. That key is retired, and the dataset dimension carries `dateGranularity: 'month'`.
- **`.describe()` kept:** the schema's `.describe('Widget configuration — declared query keys + open renderer extras')` is quoted in `@objectstack/sdui-parser`'s lockstep header and in objectui's copy, so rewording it is a cross-repo lockstep edit. It was left unchanged.
